lines.en: Even when they're magnified It's hard to see their features.
lines.zh: 即使被放大，也很难看清它们的特征。

lines.en: They're tiny, infinitesimal, so small it makes you doubt.
lines.zh: 它们非常微小，小到让你怀疑。

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到了修理工，千万别泄露他们的秘密！

lines.en: The Oven
lines.zh: 烤箱

lines.en: Now, here he is, our def-defying acrobat!
lines.zh: 瞧，他来了，我们那个爱找借口的杂技演员！

lines.en: Nolik, don't! I'm not Nolik, I'm an acrobat!
lines.zh: 诺利克，别！我不是诺利克，我是杂技演员！

lines.en: You're going to fall! I'm not going to!
lines.zh: 你会掉下来的！我才不会！

lines.en: I see. Every single time with him it's the same old story.
lines.zh: 每次看到他，都是老一套

lines.en: He gets himself into trouble and I've got to get him out of it!
lines.zh: 他总是给自己惹麻烦

lines.en: No, no, no! I'm falling! Why?
lines.zh: 然后我就得……

lines.en: Hold on! I'm just joking. Nolik, you're a knucklehead!
lines.zh: 等等！我开玩笑的。诺利克，你这个笨蛋！

lines.en: Zibka! Toola! We're down here!
lines.zh: 我们在这儿呢

lines.en: Look who's in trouble this time, he?
lines.zh: 看看这次是谁惹麻烦了。

lines.en: This isn't funny at all! Need some help?
lines.zh: 这可一点都不好笑，需要帮忙。

lines.en: We can manage this ourselves. Right, Toola?
lines.zh: 我们自己能搞定，对吧，图拉？

lines.en: Well, alright then. See you later! We gotta get out of here!
lines.zh: 好吧，那待会儿见，我们得走了。

lines.en: Tom Thomas' mom is coming! Hide!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯的妈妈来了！快躲起来！

lines.en: Hi, Tom Thomas!
lines.zh: 嗨，汤姆·托马斯！

lines.en: Hi, Nolik! Are you up for a ride?
lines.zh: 你准备好了吗？搭车

lines.en: Because this train is leaving the station. Nice place!
lines.zh: 因为这列火车要离开车站了。好地方

lines.en: It's the oven! It's beautiful in here! And not hot at all!
lines.zh: 这是烤箱，里面真漂亮，一点也不热

lines.en: Splendid! It isn't hot right now, because it only started warming up. It's hot!
lines.zh: 太棒了，现在不热是因为它才刚开始升温。

lines.en: An oven is a cabinet with a heater.
lines.zh: 烤箱就是一个带加热器的柜子

lines.en: It can get so hot inside that it will roast whatever is in there.
lines.zh: 里面温度会很高，把里面的东西都烤熟。

lines.en: As a matter of fact, that's what ovens are for.
lines.zh: 事实上，烤箱就是用来烤肉的

lines.en: People roast meat inside of them and bake things too.
lines.zh: 人们在里面烤东西。

lines.en: Some ovens burn gas for heat and others use electricity.
lines.zh: 有些烤箱烧煤气加热，有些用电

lines.en: They have special electric coils that get red
lines.zh: 它们有特殊的电热丝，会变得通红

lines.en: hot and heat everything that's inside the oven.
lines.zh: 加热烤箱里的所有东西。

lines.en: So be careful around ovens. A hot oven can burn you very badly!
lines.zh: 所以在烤箱附近要小心，热烤箱会严重烫伤你。

lines.en: It really is getting so hot!
lines.zh: 哦，真的好热

lines.en: We gotta get out of this oven right away!
lines.zh: 我们得赶紧离开这个烤箱

lines.en: Samka, we're about to get roasted in here!
lines.zh: 辛卡，我们快要被烤熟了，是的

lines.en: Yeah! Inside of a fresh baked fixie cake!
lines.zh: 在一个刚出炉的固定齿轮蛋糕里。

lines.en: I don't want to! You think I do?
lines.zh: 我不想这样，你以为我想吗？

lines.en: Here, grab on tight! This way!
lines.zh: 这边走。

lines.en: Be careful or you'll fall off!
lines.zh: 小心点，你会掉下去的。

lines.en: You're just like Simka.
lines.zh: 啊

lines.en: She told me the same thing and then she was the one who fell.
lines.zh: 你就像她跟我说的那样。

lines.en: Right into the batter. To be fair, Simka was the one who fell.
lines.zh: 正好掉进了面糊里。

lines.en: Together with Toola! What? They both fell in the dough?
lines.zh: 然后她和图拉一起掉进了面糊里，她们俩都掉进了面团里。

lines.en: Oh yeah, and they're probably still stuck in there too.
lines.zh: 哦，对了，她们可能还卡在里面呢。汤姆·托马斯

lines.en: Tom Thomas, the cake's fresh out of the oven.
lines.zh: 蛋糕刚出炉

lines.en: Do you want to try some? Where could they be, huh?
lines.zh: 你想尝尝吗？她们可能在哪儿？

lines.en: I don't know. Maybe they're inside the cake.
lines.zh: 嗯，我不知道，也许她们在蛋糕里面

lines.en: They could have turned into screws.
lines.zh: 她们可能变成螺丝了。

lines.en: We gotta find them!
lines.zh: 我们得找到她们。

lines.en: Hey, what are you doing? Eat! Stop playing!
lines.zh: 嘿，你在干什么？吃东西，别玩了！

lines.en: Hey, watch out! You could break your teeth!
lines.zh: 嘿，小心点，你会崩掉牙的！

lines.en: The first ovens in ancient homes were nothing more
lines.zh: 古代家庭最早的烤箱只不过是简单的火坑

lines.en: than simple fire pits where people cooked on hot coals.
lines.zh: 人们用热炭做饭。

lines.en: Later on the stove was invented.
lines.zh: 后来，炉灶被发明出来

lines.en: Every house had a stove made out of stone, clay, or cast iron.
lines.zh: 每家每户都有一个用石头、粘土或铸铁制成的炉灶

lines.en: People would burn wood or coal in them.
lines.zh: 人们在里面烧木头或煤。

lines.en: These stoves produced enough heat to make soup or bake a cake.
lines.zh: 这些炉灶产生的热量足以煮汤或烤蛋糕。

lines.en: And then in the nineteenth century the gas stove was invented.
lines.zh: 然后在19世纪，煤气灶被发明出来。

lines.en: Gas stoves are much more practical than wood -burning stoves.
lines.zh: 煤气灶比柴火炉实用得多

lines.en: One second and the gas is burning.
lines.zh: 一秒钟煤气就燃烧了

lines.en: A few more minutes and the water is boiling.
lines.zh: 几分钟水就烧开了。

lines.en: They're very convenient, but they can also be dangerous.
lines.zh: 它们非常方便，但也可能很危险

lines.en: Because if the pipes aren't in good condition, there can be an explosion.
lines.zh: 因为如果管道状况不好，可能会……今天发生了爆炸

lines.en: Today there are also stoves and ovens that run with electricity.
lines.zh: 现在也有用电的炉灶和烤箱了

lines.en: They use electric heating elements for frying,
lines.zh: 它们使用电加热元件来煎、煮或烤食物

lines.en: boiling, or baking foods without fire at all.
lines.zh: 完全不用火。

lines.en: Tom Thomas, I think you'll explode! But it's so incredibly good!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯，我觉得他会爆炸，但这东西太好吃了

lines.en: I just can't stop eating it!
lines.zh: 我根本停不下来。嗯

lines.en: Keep chewing, Tom Thomas! That's as much as I can chew.
lines.zh: 继续嚼。汤姆·托马斯，我只能嚼这么多了。真的。嘿

lines.en: Hey, what are you guys up to? Up to?
lines.zh: 你们在干什么？呃，干什么？

lines.en: We're trying to save you!
lines.zh: 我们在救你。

lines.en: You're not in the cake?
lines.zh: 你不在蛋糕里？

lines.en: Then how come I was eating all of this?
lines.zh: 那我为什么吃了这么多？

lines.en: I hate cake.
lines.zh: 我讨厌蛋糕。嗯

lines.en: Maybe it's because that's what good friends do.
lines.zh: 呃，也许是因为好朋友就该这么做。

lines.en: Yeah, he's a good friend who's got a really good appetite.
lines.zh: 是啊，他是个好朋友，他真的很有
